description: Fix an off-by-one that drops the last partial page of a paginated list.
instruction: The test suite in `test/pagination.test.js` fails: `splitIntoPages` in `src/pagination.js` drops a trailing partial page, and returns no page at all when there are fewer items than the page size. Fix `src/pagination.js` with the smallest change that makes `node --test` pass. Do not modify the test file.
